newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica still interested in Portugal.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica still interested in Portugal.

text.p: Spanish telecoms operator Telefonica de Espana SA said it is interested in the Portuguese market, but declined to comment on any concrete plans at this early stage, a spokesman for the company told Reuters.

A report in financial daily Cinco Dias on Tuesday said Telefonica was planning to enter the Portuguese market by bidding for a stake in Portugal Telecom. Telefonica would reportedly use the move to reinforce a future position in the Brazilian market.
"We've said we're interested in Portugal, but in a very general sense. There's been no date set for the privatisation there," the spokesman said when asked to comment on the newspaper article.
The Portuguese government floated 22 percent of Portugal Telecom in June. The sale was oversubscribed and a further one is likely in due course.
Telefonica said last month it had joined a consortium to bid for 35 percent of Brazil's Companhia Riograndense de Telecomunicacoes, due to be sold by the end of this year.
